name: Generic keyboard + mouse game
description: Fallback interface for a game with no dedicated integration: WASD-style movement, mouse-look camera, and the usual action keys.

vision.prompt: Describe the game screen for a player: what is visible, what the HUD says, and what the most likely next action is.

notes: This is the generic high-level interface. Use game_observe to see the screen, game_look to aim, game_move to walk, and game_action for named actions. Edit the keybinds to match the game's own settings.
